tools.name: pause_automation
tools.description: Stop placing new runs until it is resumed (orders already running keep delivering). Nothing is charged while paused.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation, update_automation · Private data: find_services, create_automation, add_automation_link · Public sink: find_services, place_order, get_top_up_info, create_automation, update_automation, add_automation_link · Destructive: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation, list_automations, get_automation, cancel_automation, add_automation_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation, update_automation · Private data: find_services, create_automation, add_automation_link · Public sink: find_services, place_order, get_top_up_info, create_automation, update_automation, add_automation_link · Destructive: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation, list_automations, get_automation, cancel_automation, add_automation_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
